purpose: Reconcile the current Glob 99073 continuation against the existing Worldshepherd registry, route every substantive source or information item surfaced in this pass, and explicitly mark newly discovered material.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, technical manual, internal project input, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.discovery_status: Use NEWLY_DISCOVERED only when the item was not already represented in the recovered registry/ledger set inspected in this pass; use REVERIFIED_EXISTING for already represented evidence that was independently rechecked.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, aggregator records, search-result copies, navigation pages, and repeated publications are provenance aliases rather than independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.claims_boundary: A number match does not become physical evidence merely because the surrounding source is scientific. Physical-value, relational, metadata, and incidental-control classes remain separate.
